final:
ends_swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex ends_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex ends_swapped([7]) == [7]
  ex ends_swapped([]) == []
  var res = copy xs
  swap_ends(&res)
  res

swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  post xs.len() >= 0
  ex swap_ends([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex swap_ends([7]) == [7]
  ex swap_ends([]) == []
  let n = xs.len()
  if n < 2
    return
  let first = xs[0]
  xs[0] = xs[n - 1]
  xs[n - 1] = first

test_swap_ends() =
  assert ends_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  assert ends_swapped([7]) == [7]
  assert ends_swapped([]) == []
  var ys = [4, 5, 6, 7]
  swap_ends(&ys)
  assert ys == [7, 5, 6, 4]
